title: SetErrorType Display impl duplicates serde rename_all=camelCase
description: backend.rs SetErrorType has both #[serde(rename_all='camelCase')] AND a manual Display impl that repeats every camelCase string. The two must be kept in sync by hand. If a variant is added and Display is forgotten the wire format diverges from the string representation. Fix: derive serde with rename_all, and implement Display by serializing to a JSON string via serde_json::to_value(self).unwrap().as_str() — or use a const array approach that is DRY.
